claims.statement: All 13 requested entries have distinct identity and interface records; none has a locally observed Recursion integration run.
claims.applicability_limit: Source identity resolution does not certify eligibility or ten-control conformance.
claims.contradictory_evidence: A richer interface can invalidate a wrapper-only limitation.
claims.decisive_test: Pin each installed build and negotiate capabilities without credentials or effects before an authorized sandbox probe.

claims.statement: ChatGPT subscription sign-in is a documented Codex path, not general native API entitlement; upstream-only admission must close every reasoning and auxiliary route.
claims.applicability_limit: Account and intended distribution eligibility remain unverified.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Some enterprise automation tokens and coding subscriptions use keys without ordinary API billing.
claims.decisive_test: Remove direct API credentials in an isolated approved fixture and exercise planning, implementation, review, compaction, consultation and recovery with pool accounting.

claims.statement: Cursor first-party SDK exposes local active steering, while cloud or detached steering becomes a follow-up; resumed runtime options must be reapplied.
claims.applicability_limit: Current documents are not an installed SDK certificate; foreground child behavior remains separately scoped.
claims.contradictory_evidence: ACP-only inspection misses SDK controls; local autoReview is not a security boundary.
claims.decisive_test: Compare local steer delivery, detached follow-up, surviving child and resumed tool grants at the exact SDK version.

claims.statement: The independent Cursor ACP adapter at 0.9.1 uses the SDK and may retry an entire turn with autoReview disabled after permission approval.
claims.applicability_limit: Author-documented mechanism; effects were not exercised.
claims.contradictory_evidence: An earlier CLI-backed description is stale; best-effort history and fork do not certify source preservation.
claims.decisive_test: Place an observable fixture effect before a denied tool and prove the retry cannot repeat it or silently broaden later grants.

claims.statement: Hermes auxiliary model routing and profile clone exclusions require explicit role closure and canonical recovery outside upstream state.
claims.applicability_limit: Repository mechanisms at one pin; no provider entitlement inferred.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Shared refresh state, frozen memory and destructive rewind undermine naive clone or live-memory assumptions.
claims.decisive_test: Revoke a remembered instruction and omit all unadmitted providers, then inspect auxiliary calls and cloned-history completeness.

claims.statement: Claude subscription usage, third-party OAuth approval, unmodified-binary hosting, deferred questions and tool mediation are separate contracts.
claims.applicability_limit: Terms assessment and callback coverage need route-specific validation before distribution.
claims.contradictory_evidence: June 15 paused the previously announced SDK credit change; PreToolUse does not cover every context file read.
claims.decisive_test: Verify intended personal versus distributed route, deferred question resume, automatic approvals and file/descendant bypasses at frozen versions.

claims.statement: Muse Code is Meta's terminal beta; Antigravity local SDK and managed API are separate execution routes; Gemini and Grok source/binary promises remain version-specific.
claims.applicability_limit: No Muse embedding protocol or universal Windows support established; provider billing differs.
claims.contradictory_evidence: A model announcement, experimental ACP flag or source build is not the same contract as an installed harness.
claims.decisive_test: Run identity and host capability probes separately; retain unsupported cells and do not substitute a similarly named product.

claims.statement: One deterministic admission and accounting plane can serve native, upstream-only and combined role bindings without idle model inference.
claims.applicability_limit: Recursion loop and adapters are not implemented or performance-certified.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Opaque upstream auxiliary use can prevent strict cost closure; pure status and timers do not need inference.
claims.decisive_test: Replay a complete upstream-only workflow and an idle interval with direct API credentials absent and every inference attributed.

claims.statement: Persistent AssistantIdentity should link versioned profiles, sessions and goal-scoped role leases without becoming a new executive tier.
claims.applicability_limit: Object projection proposed only; ArmRun and GoalSpec contracts remain immutable.
claims.contradictory_evidence: A shared account computer or profile is not task isolation; virtual actors bring runtime dependencies.
claims.decisive_test: Compare reconstructed and resident assistants across goal change, revocation, dormant population and stale memory.

claims.statement: Consultation needs bounded messages, current authority and attributable decisions; advice alone cannot amend a GoalSpec.
claims.applicability_limit: Current GoalSpec amendments remain Owner-only; a future delegated class needs an explicit amendment.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Agent interoperability does not prevent cycles, stale replies or unauthorized decision rights.
claims.decisive_test: Inject cyclic referrals, delayed revocation and cross-goal advice; reject stale decisions and enforce shared reservations.

claims.statement: Aggressive, Full and Lazy Stop require distinct scope and boundary receipts, resource containment and relaunch fencing; cancellation does not establish rollback.
claims.applicability_limit: Unreachable hosts and external effects retain uncertainty; current operational PAUSE is unchanged.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Process breakaway, supervisor restart and late completion defeat PID-only or acknowledgment-only Stop.
claims.decisive_test: Kill and reconnect controlled process trees, race cancellation with committed effects and require per-scope settlement evidence.

claims.statement: Preserved forks require a coherent source snapshot, separate derived writes and conserved parent reservations; neither conversation fork nor worktree add copies all unfinished work.
claims.applicability_limit: Snapshot protocol remains unrun and must handle untracked, ignored, binary and concurrent edits.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Stash push mutates the source; filesystem and conversation histories can diverge.
claims.decisive_test: Fork during concurrent edits with index/untracked fixtures; compare source before/after and reject falsely coherent snapshots.

claims.statement: Configuration changes need immutable revisions, field-specific merge rules, explicit effective boundaries and immediate authority revocation fences.
claims.applicability_limit: Outstanding-session propagation does not authorize in-flight grant widening.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Resumed tools or roots may need explicit resupply; waiting for a checkpoint cannot postpone a required revocation.
claims.decisive_test: Race an edit with active tools, queued dispatch, dormant resume and child spawn under both propagation modes.

claims.statement: Plugin portability requires a semantic loss map across tools, context, UI, auth, lifecycle and dependencies; incompatible invocation can return a deterministic no-effect receipt.
claims.applicability_limit: Local execution is separate from offline operation and local inference; four responses stay configurable.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Startup dependency installs, browser cookies and host-specific hooks break metadata-only portability.
claims.decisive_test: Invoke an incompatible route and assert zero process/model/network/install effects while retaining the visible marker and receipt.

claims.statement: All six update modes need admission snapshots and per-host activation receipts; compatible executable rollback is one strategy, not universal state or task recovery.
claims.applicability_limit: Failure outcomes and compatibility windows are proposed; no migration or update performed.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Destructive schema contraction, missing retained slots and offline hosts can require repair-forward or isolation.
claims.decisive_test: Fault every staging/activation boundary and verify newest history, readable state, work preservation and resumability separately.

claims.statement: Relative recovery allowance should use cumulative componentwise reservations across repeated failures and provider resets; zero or unknown prior use cannot create fresh funds.
claims.applicability_limit: Arithmetic is locally checkable; actual provider counters, units and observation delays remain unproven.
claims.contradictory_evidence: A pool reset changes availability, not prior consumption; unlike units cannot be silently added.
claims.decisive_test: Model repeated, zero, delayed, unknown and shared-pool usage with exact rational fractions and outstanding ambiguous reservations.

claims.statement: Authentic releases, retained executable instances and pilot recovery are reusable mechanisms, but none proves semantic rollback of arbitrary remote effects.
claims.applicability_limit: TUF protects target metadata and version selection; pilot results are system-specific.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Rollback protection must not be bypassed to select old binaries; a newly signed release may intentionally contain compatible older code.
claims.decisive_test: Test revoked/expired metadata, unavailable slots, activation timeout and remote acceptance without receipt; require reconciliation before retry.

claims.statement: The smallest aggregate plus an explicit bounded broker refinement is the recommended first proof boundary, with a broker-inclusive model retained as an alternative.
claims.applicability_limit: Owner choice pending; six existing M1 obligations and OR-015 remain unchanged.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Separating the broker can hide queue or relaunch races unless refinement assumptions are executable and bounded.
claims.decisive_test: Search bounded consultation, queue saturation, RESET, epoch, update/Stop and returning-worker traces before model freeze.

claims.statement: Larger context, caching and model keepalive are value hypotheses; evaluate the full workflow, including changed instructions, compaction, failed attempts and no future work.
claims.applicability_limit: API cache rules are model-specific and do not establish subscription savings or memory correctness.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Cache writes can cost more, compaction changes prefixes, and untracked auxiliary headers can destroy affinity.
claims.decisive_test: Compare cold/warm/reconstructed continuation with revoked instructions and measure landed quality plus every call and review cost.

claims.statement: Lean verification and resource presets must follow matched full-workflow baselines, independently assessed outcomes and explicit unavailable counters.
claims.applicability_limit: No numeric product minimum, speedup, quality gain or optimal verifier count has been measured.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Selection bias, shared tasks and resource enforcement can manufacture apparent gains.
claims.decisive_test: Randomize paired task order, freeze guaranteed and maximum resources, retain failures and assess final artifacts without treatment labels.

claims.statement: Reuse protocols and OS primitives, adapt harness/plugin surfaces, and build only the missing canonical integrity layer; larger frameworks require measured removal criteria.
claims.applicability_limit: Language, store and framework are unselected; reference feature availability is not integration fit.
claims.contradictory_evidence: A framework may save code while imposing runtime, lifecycle or authority coupling greater than the requirement.
claims.decisive_test: Compare a bounded adapter/projection against the smallest reference implementation and remove dependencies that add no measurable contract or workflow value.

claims.statement: The foundation is ready for bounded source-informed probes and model-boundary decisions, while complete route and formal-contract readiness remains conditional.
claims.applicability_limit: Research completion is distinct from integration validation, implementation readiness and release certification.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Launch-critical names cannot be silently dropped to turn unknown support into a green matrix.
claims.decisive_test: Close launch-critical identity, eligibility, ten-control, role accounting and failure traces before the formal-model freeze decision.

claims.statement: Grok Build has source-documented native question outcomes, compaction extensions and buffered interjection; fail-open hooks cannot be its authority fence.
claims.applicability_limit: Interjection external wire discovery and Build-specific subscription eligibility remain unproven.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Basic CLI inspection misses richer controls, while internal source support still does not certify an external API.
claims.decisive_test: Discover native extension capabilities, race interjection with idle/cancel and fail a PreToolUse hook while an independent gate denies effects.

claims.statement: Richer Gemini core, OpenCode question and Claude streaming interfaces narrow control gaps but expose separate waiter durability and helper-accounting limits.
claims.applicability_limit: Internal core adaptation differs from supported public SDK; all runtime conformance remains unrun.
claims.contradictory_evidence: Tool approval is not general questions; cumulative model_usage excludes some helpers and must not be summed across results.
claims.decisive_test: Kill a pending waiter, resume streaming interrupt receipts and reconcile latest cumulative usage plus excluded helper counters without double charging.
